description: This file defines the 'NotesListScreen' React component for a notes application. It manages state for notes, search query, sorting, tagging, and loading from an API. The component renders a header, search and filter controls, a list of note cards, and a floating action button to create new notes. It integrates navigation to a note detail view and an about screen.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches notes and tags from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Creates a new note and navigates to its detail view.
